stage0049_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$キサカ$$
「The machines are Earth Federation make,
　but broadcasting no ID. Terrorists, likely.」

stage0049_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$カガリ$$
「At a time like this...!
　The Federation hasn't even sent help yet!?」

stage0049_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$サイガス$$
「You seem to be struggling, Representative Athha.」

stage0049_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$サイガス$$
「I'm afraid the Pacific Branch's relief force
　will arrive later than expected.」

stage0049_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$サイガス$$
「I offer my prayers for the brave fight
　of Orb's renowned militia.」

stage0049_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$キサカ$$
「...word is the Federation's Pacific Branch
　is under Earth supremacists' thumb.」

stage0049_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$カガリ$$
「The enemy...was this close all along...!」

stage0049_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$シン$$
「What the hell is this...
　Wasn't UG attacking Orb...?」

stage0049_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$カガリ$$
「Can you hear me, $$シン$$?
　Those guys...might be Federation forces.」

stage0049_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$カガリ$$
「Don't make a careless move.
　If you do, your standing might...」

stage0049_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$シン$$
「I won't...!
　I won't forgive those who start wars, fights!」

stage0049_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Hey now, hey now...
　That boy pulled the needle out with rage...?」

stage0049_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「SEED...
　They'll be grieved by this too, I'd wager...」

stage0049_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$キサカ$$
「$$シン・アスカ$$!
　You're the only one who can fight for Orb
　right now! Protect the official residence!」

stage0049_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$シン$$
「I know!
　I won't even let them get close!」

stage0049_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$シン$$
「I don't care who or what you are!
　I'll protect Orb, my precious home, myself!!」

stage0049_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$シン$$
「Come on!
　If you want a war so badly,
　I'll be your opponent!!」

stage0049_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$カガリ$$
「Hang in there, $$シン$$!
　That's it! Don't lose!!」

stage0049_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$キサカ$$
「Lady $$マリナ$$... escape while he holds them off.」

stage0049_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$マリナ$$
「No...
　I'll stay here with Representative Athha.」

stage0049_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$マリナ$$
「Risking your life for what you believe in...
　Watching Representative Athha and him fight now,
　it reminds me of someone.」

stage0049_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$マリナ$$
「So as not to shame him,
　I'll see this battle through, and use it
　to bring us closer to peace, even a little.」

stage0049_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$マリナ$$
（$$刹那$$...
　I'm sure you're still fighting, even now...）

stage0049_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$カガリ$$
「$$キサカ$$...!
　What's the evacuation status!?」

stage0049_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$キサカ$$
「According to Captain Ramius's report,
　45% of citizens have evacuated the main island.」

stage0049_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$キサカ$$
「If the fighting drags on,
　the war will eventually reach the evac routes too.」

stage0049_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$カガリ$$
「$$シン$$'s doing well, but...
　there's only so much one person can do...」

stage0049_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$シン$$
（Lose? Like hell I'll lose...!
　For $$カミーユ$$ and the others who sent me,
　and for Mayu, Dad, and Mom resting here...!）

stage0049_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$シン$$
「This is bad!
　They'll break through!!」

stage0049_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$キラ$$
「Looks like I made it just in time.」

stage0049_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$シン$$
「You came from $$プラント$$ in the Freedom?」

stage0049_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$キラ$$
「I've done it before.
　Heard Orb was a target, and rushed out here.」

stage0049_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$キラ$$
「Still, I felt I had to do it.」

stage0049_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$キラ$$
「Because this Orb
　is a precious place to me too.」

stage0049_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Now that's a surprise...
　Inspired by that other kid,
　even that boy's needle came loose...」

stage0049_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「This is bad, $$アンナロッタ$$...
　If those kids make contact with the $$烙印$$ crowd,
　this could snowball fast.」

stage0049_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「If we wait and watch, we'll be scrambling too late...」

stage0049_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$キラ$$
「Almost there, $$シン$$!
　Let's do this!」

stage0049_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$キラ$$
「That's thanks to your hard work, $$シン$$.」

stage0049_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$シン$$
（$$カミーユ$$, everyone...
　Mayu, Dad, Mom...）

stage0049_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$シン$$
（I... finally, in the truest sense,
　made it back home to Orb...）

stage0049_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「I was happy to watch Earthlings
　grind each other down, but not anymore, it seems...」

stage0049_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「All units, begin the attack.
　Leave this nation be, and it'll hinder our plans.」

stage0049_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$キラ$$
「They're the ones who told $$プラント$$
　about Orb, too.」

stage0049_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$刹那$$
「I know the pain of losing a precious place...」

stage0049_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Direct hit, for starters.
　The Zanbanya's handling ain't bad.」

stage0049_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Thanks for the support.
　$$ハロ$$, $$青ハロ$$.」

stage0049_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$刹那$$
「Today, I'll expose your entire scheme...!」

stage0049_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$シン$$
「So Celestial Being was after UG.」

stage0049_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「That's right, $$シン$$.
　It's been a while.」

stage0049_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Sorry for being late, desu, $$アスカ$$, Yamato!」

stage0049_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$ラッセ$$
「Your resolve to protect your homeland,
　I hear it loud and clear.」

stage0049_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$刹那$$
「Greetings can wait.
　Right now, we corner them.」

stage0049_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$テッサ$$
「They were acting separately from $c,
　investigating UG's movements.」

stage0049_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Feels weird, huh.
　Fighting alongside the same guys we used to
　scrap with, back during the $$破界事変$$.」

stage0049_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$マオ$$
「In your case, you had a fated rival, after all.」

stage0049_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「If $c has come too, all the better...!
　We'll wipe out our obstacles, all at once!」

stage0049_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$キラ$$
「There were people living here in peace...
　And yet, for your own selfish reasons,
　you're trying to steal their happiness away...!」

stage0049_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「We already know full well
　that you're attacking Orb to keep the war
　between Earth and the colonies going.」

stage0049_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Yes, that's right.
　At every inexplicable clash between Earth
　and the colonies, their agents were there...」

stage0049_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「It was that UG who sparked the war
　between the Federation and Neo Zeon...!」

stage0049_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「They're the root cause of the war...」

stage0049_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$甲児$$
「So it was these guys, using hypnosis
　to stir up all that chaos!!」

stage0049_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$バナージ$$
「No way... to think someone's hand
　was truly behind starting this war...」

stage0049_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$シン$$
「You cowards!
　Hiding who you are, sneaking around starting wars!!」

stage0049_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$シン$$
「You're the absolute worst!!
　Because of you, how many people have...!」

stage0049_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「We too...! We too...!」

stage0049_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$n
「Your reasons mean nothing to me.
　But what you've done, we will
　never, ever forgive...!」

stage0049_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$n
「$$アンナロッタ・ストールス$$!
　Don't think someone like you has any right to talk!」

stage0049_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Silence...! Silence!
　We are no cowards!」

stage0049_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「We are the Sidereal...
　No, that's wrong!」

stage0049_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「We are the Geminis!
　Protectors of Geminai, the Geminaid!」

stage0049_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$シモン$$
「Geminis...!
　So that's UG's true name!」

stage0049_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$タケル$$
「Planet Geminai...!
　Then they're not from Earth!?」

stage0049_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Now that I've unsealed this $$ディオスク$$,
　know that you stand no chance!」

stage0049_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$n
「Coward...!
　Anyone who talks that big
　can't be all that strong!」

stage0049_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$n
「...Even now, I'm scared enough to want to scream...」

stage0049_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$n
「But...!
　The anger inside me isn't soft enough
　to let a guy like that run free!」

stage0049_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Understood, $n...!
　I'll back you up with everything I've got!」

stage0049_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, intercept UG, the Geminis!
　If their goal is war between Earth and the colonies,
　we can't let them have Orb, of all places!」

stage0049_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Scumbags scheming against Earth from the shadows!
　No need to hold back!」

stage0049_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$桂$$
「OK!
　I'm pissed off too, this time!」

stage0049_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$刹那$$, $$ロックオン$$!
　Formation F32!」

stage0049_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Come at me if you dare, $c!」

stage0049_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Now that I've named myself Geminis, I cannot lose!
　On the pride of the Geminaid,
　I will win this battle!!」

stage0049_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Trying hard, aren't you, little $$アンナロッタ$$.
　Guess unsealing the $$ディオスク$$ was worth it.」

stage0049_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Now then... how will that guy over there move...」

stage0049_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$n
「It seems we can't afford
　to drag this fight out any longer...」

stage0049_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Such a sloppy attack!
　That won't be enough to fell the Geminis's $$ディオスク$$!」

stage0049_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「You who sullied the Geminis's, no...
　the Geminaid's pride, I'll finish here!」

stage0049_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$アルト$$
「Damn it!
　I can't back him up from here...!」

stage0049_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「A chance!
　I'll finish him off!」

stage0049_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I won't let you touch him.」

stage0049_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Ngh!
　What is this guy...!?」

stage0049_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Sorry about that.
　I had to be rough to stop you.」

stage0049_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「An ally of that white machine...!」

stage0049_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「There's nothing to worry about.
　That's my ally, meaning yours as well.」

stage0049_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「...To all units.
　From here, I'll be supporting $c.」

stage0049_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「All units, head to the island's north
　and help the citizens evacuate.」

stage0049_04:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$アマタ$$
「They say they're an ally, but...」

stage0049_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「There's no time to explain.
　First, I'll back you up.」

stage0049_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Keep your heart strong.
　Unless you overcome the fear inside you,
　you won't win the battles ahead.」

stage0049_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Let's go.
　We'll take down that woman, $$アンナロッタ$$!」

stage0049_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That's it.
　Show me the possibility within you.」

stage0049_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「At least they don't seem hostile...」

stage0049_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$オズマ$$
「$n!
　I'm leaving that guy's handling to you!
　If he acts up, take him down!」

stage0049_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$カガリ$$
「Lady $$マリナ$$!
　Orb has been protected!」

stage0049_04:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$マリナ$$
「Yes.
　I believe Representative Athha's strong will called them here.」

stage0049_04:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$フェルト$$
「$$刹那$$...
　I hear Princess $$マリナ・イスマイール$$
　is in Orb right now, but...」

stage0049_04:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$刹那$$
「There's no need to meet her.
　She and I may aim for the same goal,
　but we walk different paths.」

stage0049_04:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「My name is $$アドヴェント$$...
　That's all I can tell you for now.」

stage0049_04:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
Trooper
「We've mopped up the enemy units
　that drifted to the island's north.」

stage0049_04:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
Trooper
「Civilian evacuation is complete as well.
　Though it's probably unnecessary now.」

stage0049_04:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Well done.
　...But the battle here was a trivial matter.」

stage0049_04:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Humanity's history is about to reach its end...
　What we truly need to fight
　is that fact.」

stage0049_04:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$テッサ$$
（That person calling himself $$アドヴェント$$...
　could he know about $$エタニティ・フラット$$...?）

stage0049_04:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「N23-32, E161-22...
　The key to the truth lies there.」

stage0049_04:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「See it all with your own eyes.
　That is our wish as well.」

stage0049_04:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I'm glad we got to fight together today, like this.
　Until we meet again, $c.」

stage0049_04:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$ブライト$$
「I don't know...
　There's no data on them anywhere.」

stage0049_04:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Sheesh... and after deploying the $$ディオスク$$,
　to end up with this result.」

stage0049_04:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Though little $$アンナロッタ$$
　can't draw out the $$ディオスク$$'s power like that...」

stage0049_04:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「The problem's that guy over there.
　Leaving behind one hell of a parting gift...」

stage0049_04:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Geez... don't go dragging
　your troubles into that town...」

stage0049_04:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Geminis... and the end of humanity's history...」

stage0049_04:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$シン$$
「Damn it!
　Are we gradually being pushed back!?」

stage0049_04:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$シン$$
「But I'll pull through!
　He's putting his life on the line too!」

stage0049_04:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「What is this...!
　To be defeated even with this $$ディオスク$$...!」

stage0049_04:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Is this... a problem with me myself...!」

stage0049_04:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$n
「Wait, $$アンナロッタ・ストールス$$!」

stage0049_04:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「No need to chase her, $F.
　A day will come to settle things with her too.」

stage0049_04:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「For now, focus on what's in front of you.」

stage0049_04:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$n
（Just who is this person...
　Every word carries a force that allows no refusal...）

stage0049_04:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Ahh... that guy too, huh...
　At this rate, Newtypes are probably
　gonna keep waking up left and right...」

stage0049_04:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「...Geez, my troubles keep piling up...
　Guess this is payback for complaining I was bored...」

stage0049_04:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$シン$$
「Alright...!
　At this rate, we'll manage somehow!」

stage0049_04:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$シン$$
（I'll protect it...!
　Orb... my home!）

stage0049_04:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$シン$$
（My head's clearing up...
　Even though I should be filled with rage,
　I read the enemy and myself like an open book...!）

stage0049_04:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$シン$$
（At this rate, I should be able to
　draw out Destiny's full power!）

stage0049_04:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$キラ$$
（Orb is where I have memories with $$ラクス$$ and Mom...
　And in the world to come,
　it should play an important role.）

stage0049_04:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$キラ$$
（I'll protect it...!
　I won't let this island burn in war again!）

stage0049_04:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$キラ$$
「Count on me, $$シン$$.
　Though I'm standing in for $$ルナマリア$$.」

stage0049_04:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$シン$$
「Same here, standing in for $$アスラン$$.」

stage0049_04:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$キラ$$
「...Let's stop that.
　I brought it up myself, but right now,
　it's just you and me here.」

stage0049_04:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$シン$$
「That's right.
　Let's show a combo that would make
　Luna and $$アスラン$$ jealous!」

stage0049_04:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$刹那$$
（Even in this ever-changing world,
　our role to fulfill remains the same...）

stage0049_04:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$刹那$$
（Eradicate war...!
　For that, we, Celestial Being, fight!）

stage0049_04:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Now then...!
　Time to show these familiar faces
　my new combat style and Zanbanya!」

stage0049_04:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Here we go!
　$$ロックオン・ストラトス$$...!
　Zanbanya, all guns blazing!!」

stage0049_04:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$フェルト$$
「Distance 2000!
　That's the Ptolemy's combat range!」

stage0049_04:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$ラッセ$$
「Ready to go anytime!
　Just give the word!」

stage0049_04:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「...Sadly, peace hasn't come to the world yet...」

stage0049_04:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「So we'll seize it with our own hands!
　Ptolemy, commence attack!」

stage0049_04:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「I'm grateful to you!
　For giving me this chance to name myself!」

stage0049_04:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$n
「Do whatever you want!
　I have no interest in your existence!」

stage0049_04:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$n
「You cowardly scum are an eyesore,
　so I'll just clean you up!」

stage0049_04:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「I retract what I said earlier!
　In the end, you're nothing but an imitation!」

stage0049_04:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「I, $$アンナロッタ・ストールス$$,
　will execute you for sullying the Geminis's pride!!」

stage0049_04:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Don't let momentum carry you...!
　Read the battle calmly!」

stage0049_04:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Just what are you...!?
　Showing up out of nowhere and jerking $n around...!」

stage0049_04:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「It seems he understands instinctively
　what's needed to grow stronger.」

stage0049_04:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「It's a joyous thing.
　To have met someone like you.」

stage0049_04:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$n
（Strange...
　This person's words sink into my chest so easily...）

stage0049_04:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$n
（What is this...
　Do I... know this person somehow...?）
